tasks.title: Define narrow platform facts and adapters
tasks.description: Keep common code on portable .NET APIs. Add purpose-owned contracts only where behavior genuinely differs: root defaults, filesystem semantics, key/vault backend, native permission hardening, and optional capability probes.

tasks.title: Select implementations at composition
tasks.description: Register exactly one mandatory implementation per profile and zero-or-one optional adapters. Avoid conditional compilation unless a native reference cannot be isolated otherwise.

tasks.title: Create capability/readiness descriptors
tasks.description: Report availability, reason, remediation, support level, implementation registration, identity, optional truthful version, and execution boundary without exposing secrets or full sensitive paths.

tasks.title: Fail fast for mandatory security/path defects
tasks.description: The host must not start in a production profile with an unsupported secret provider, unusable control-plane root, insecure key permissions, or ambiguous migration.

tasks.title: Degrade optional features independently
tasks.description: Desktop open, terminal presentation, native process discovery, FileTools, and other runtime capabilities can be unavailable without blocking headless core startup.

tasks.title: Add architecture enforcement
tasks.description: Add dependency/scan tests that prevent a broad IPlatformService, OS branching in domain/process semantics, and reverse MAF-to-product ownership.

tasks.title: Prove profile matrix
tasks.description: Test Windows interactive, Linux headless, Linux interactive-keyring, macOS interactive, macOS headless/service, and explicit test profiles.

tasks.title: Issue composition gate C3a
tasks.description: Require consistent capability UI/API/readiness snapshots and no misleading support claims.
